source_claim: AlphaEvolve compares long-running searches, ablations, and repeated seeds, so lineage replay evidence must distinguish deterministic loop-owned ids from direct UUID defaults and provider outputs that are not replayed.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve runtime manifests validate runtime.lineage_replay_policy, including deterministic loop-created seed and generated candidate ids, deterministic PromptDatabase seed and mutated template ids, deterministic ordered LLM call ids, explicit exclusion of direct Program() and PromptProgram() UUID4 defaults, provider-output non-replay metadata, runtime RNG linkage, LLM scheduler linkage, archive snapshot linkage, prompt-history replay linkage, and full-resume bundle policy validation. It does not claim provider-output replay in resumed traces, controller pending-work lineage state, ordered migration lineage replay, plugin RNG state linkage, validator RNG state linkage, or end-to-end resumed lineage trace proof.
